resources.string: Your data stays on this phone. No cloud account, no tracking — Artha works entirely offline. Built for the way money actually moves in India.
We\'ll greet you with this name in the app. You can change it later in Settings.
Add one or more accounts to get started. You can edit or add more later.
Camera capture: coming in next pass
No investments yet — add one from Investments
Credit card payment — won\'t count as expense
No accounts yet — add one from Accounts
No cards yet — add one from Cards
Pick where the money comes from
Pick where the money goes to
AI Quick Entry coming in Phase 3
Add your first account from More → Accounts.
No transactions for this range yet.
Type to search across transactions, accounts, cards, people, categories, investments, and policies.
Try a shorter or different word — search is substring-match across descriptions, names, and amounts.
Unlock with biometric or device credential to continue.
No accounts yet. Tap + to add one.
No movement in the last 30 days.
No transactions yet for this account.
Archived accounts are hidden from the main list but their transactions remain. You can restore them from the Archived menu.
This permanently removes the account. Existing transactions that referenced it are kept for history but their account will appear blank. Use Archive instead if you might want it back.
%1$d transactions still reference this account. Deleting it would leave them orphaned and distort your reports. Archive it instead — its history stays intact.
%1$d transactions still reference this card. Deleting it would leave them orphaned and distort your reports. Archive it instead — its history stays intact.
%1$d transactions still reference this investment. Deleting it would leave them orphaned and distort your reports. Archive it instead — its history stays intact.
Had transactions — archived instead of deleting
No cards yet. Tap + to add one.
Credit limit must be greater than 0
No movement in the last 30 days.
No transactions yet for this card.
Archived cards are hidden from the main list but their transactions remain. You can restore them from the Archived menu.
This permanently removes the card. Existing transactions that referenced it are kept for history but their card will appear blank. Use Archive instead if you might want it back.
Category is in use by %1$d transaction(s)
System categories can be renamed but not deleted
No categories yet for this type.
This permanently removes the category. Its children become top-level. This cannot be undone.
System category — name and color are editable, type stays fixed.
Tint the UI with your wallpaper palette on Android 12+.
Spouse prompt will ask again next time
Save a complete JSON snapshot of every record — accounts, cards, categories, people, tags, transactions, investments, insurance, budgets, goals, subscriptions and rules
Wipe every record permanently — used for starting over
This deletes everything on this device — accounts, cards, transactions, custom categories. The pre-seeded categories will be re-added. Continue?
Last chance — once you tap Wipe, the data is gone. There is no backup.
Password-protected backup (AES-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256). Use this when sharing via Drive/email.
Pick a long, unique password. The backup file is useless without it — Artha has no way to recover it.
Replace all current data with a backup file (.json or encrypted .artha)
Restoring replaces ALL current data on this device with the contents of the backup. This cannot be undone. Continue?
This is an encrypted Artha backup. Enter the password it was created with.
Wrong password, or this isn\'t an Artha backup. Your data was not changed.
Couldn\'t read that backup file. Your data was not changed.
Prompt for fingerprint, face, or screen-lock on app open. Falls back to your device PIN/pattern if biometrics aren\'t enrolled.
Set up a screen lock or fingerprint in your device settings first — this phone can\'t prompt yet.
Listen for bank transaction SMS and pre-fill them for your review. Requires SMS permissions; flipping this off revokes the listener.
SMS auto-import needs SMS and notification permissions to work.
Show the \"Quick add with Gemini\" card on the Dashboard. Off by default.
A working key is saved on this device. AI Quick Entry is active.
Paste a key from aistudio.google.com/apikey. Without it, AI Quick Entry stays offline.
Disables AI Quick Entry until you paste another key
Artha will round-trip a tiny request to Google to confirm the key works. Only valid keys are saved.
Key saved — AI Quick Entry is on
Key rejected — try a new one. (%1$s)
Couldn\'t reach Gemini — try again on better signal. (%1$s)
Artha is wealth — the means, not the end. This is a personal ledger built for clarity over cleverness: see where your money is, where it goes, and whether the next decision serves the life you want.
This permanently removes the transaction and adjusts your balances. This cannot be undone.
Won\'t count as a monthly expense
Don\'t ask again — always use Transfer
Don\'t ask again — always use Expense
No tags yet. Tap + to add one.
Tag is in use by %1$d transaction(s)
This permanently removes the tag. Transactions that referenced it keep their other tags. This cannot be undone.
Net Position always stays on top.
Add a credit/debit card from More → Cards.
Type, dictate, or attach a receipt photo — Gemini will pre-fill the transaction for you to confirm.
e.g. 350 at CCD via GPay yesterday
Open Settings → AI Quick Entry to paste your Gemini API key. Without it, AI Quick Entry stays offline.
Tip ₹150 dosa at MTR near temple…
No investments yet. Tap + to add one.
No transactions yet for this investment.
This permanently removes the investment. Transactions that referenced it stay in the log for history but will no longer roll up here.
No policies yet. Tap + to add one.
e.g. Family Health Plan, HDFC Click 2 Protect
Creates a linked Investment row (type ULIP) so premiums tracked as investment buys roll up here too.
This permanently removes the policy record. A linked investment row (if any) stays — delete it separately if you want it gone too.
No rules yet. The 10 pre-seeded rules from the manual should appear here automatically.
Removes the rule. Already-saved transactions are unaffected.
This is a system rule. Deleting it means it won\'t come back unless you reset all data. Toggling it off is usually safer.
Lower numbers run first. Seeded rules use 10–90; user rules default to 100.
leave blank to match any id of that kind
No tax-eligible amounts found. Tag investments with a section (80C, 80D, …) on their detail screen.
No people yet. Add friends, family, or business contacts to track who owes whom.
Removes the person record. Past transactions tagged with them keep the (now-orphaned) tag.
No transactions tagged with this person yet.
No budgets yet. Tap + to set a monthly cap.
Removes the budget. Transactions are untouched.
No goals yet. Tap + to add one (Emergency Fund, Vacation, etc.).
Removes the goal record. Linked accounts/investments aren\'t touched.
No subscriptions yet. Add Netflix, Spotify, iCloud, etc.
Removes the subscription. Past transactions are kept.
No recurring rules yet. Use these to remind yourself of rent, EMIs, SIPs.
Note: in this build the rule is stored but auto-firing on schedule is deferred to Phase 5 (needs WorkManager). You\'ll still see it on the list as a reminder.
Removes the rule. Past transactions it created stay in the log.
Rules stored locally. Auto-firing on schedule turns on with WorkManager in Phase 5 — you\'ll still see entries here as reminders.
One-tap seed of ~3.9k Federal Bank + ICICI transactions baked into this build. Safe to retry — already-imported rows are skipped.
Imported: %1$d txns, %2$d accounts created, %3$d reused, %4$d skipped (already present).
No bundled data found in this build. Rebuild after running export-json.
Removes the Federal Bank + ICICI accounts and every transaction tagged as imported. Your manually-entered data stays.

This deletes:
• The "Federal Bank (Jupiter)" and "ICICI Bank" accounts (if present)
• Every transaction whose notes start with "Imported from"

Manually-entered accounts and transactions are untouched. Use this to retry the import after tweaking the categoriser.
